جَازِئٌ [act. part. n. of 1]. ―
-b2- هٰذَا رَجُلٌ جَازِئُكَ مِنْ رَجُلٍ This is a man sufficing thee as a man. (K, * TA.) ―
-b3- ظَبْيَةٌ جَازِئَةٌ A doe-gazelle that is satisfied with green, or fresh, pasture or herbage [so as to be in no need of water]: pl. جَوَازِئُ. (S.) The pl. is explained by IKt as meaning Gazelles: (TA:) [or] it signifies [or signifies also] Wild bulls or cows; (K, TA;) because they are satisfied with green, or fresh, pasture or herbage so as to be in no need of water. (TA.) Also, the pl., Palm-trees; as not needing irrigation. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
